def solve(g, conn):
    st = np.ones((3,3)) if conn==8 else ndimage.generate_binary_structure(2,1)
    out=np.zeros((6,6),int)
    for color in set(g.flatten().tolist())-{5}:
        mask=g==color
        lab,n=ndimage.label(mask, structure=st)
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
            if ys.max()//3==ys.min()//3 and xs.max()//3==xs.min()//3:
                out[ys.min()//3, xs.min()//3]=color
    return out

def diag_pairs(gi,go_):
    st8=np.ones((3,3)); st4=ndimage.generate_binary_structure(2,1)
    res=[]
    for color in set(gi.flatten().tolist())-{5}:
        m=gi==color
        l8,n8=ndimage.label(m,structure=st8); l4,n4=ndimage.label(m,structure=st4)
        # components under 4-conn that merge under 8-conn
        for i in range(1,n4+1):
            ys,xs=np.where(l4==i)
            if len(set(l8[ys,xs]))>1:
                res.append((color,i,ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()))
    return res
